notes: Normative for: instruction id -> actor, instruction id -> allowed message keys, and the message text itself.
Vietnamese is the primary MVP language; English is authored in parallel so the layer is localizable. Neither string may be embedded in analysis/domain code (AGENTS.md).
A rule may only suggest actions listed here for it; specs/validation/validate_specs.py enforces the whole chain rule -> action -> message key -> text.
Wording policy: describe the physical fix, never judge the person; no 'error', 'wrong', 'bad'. Lighting wording must stay relative (lighting-engine.md).
Key convention: `guidance.<domain>.<action>[.<variant>]` — the variant (side, direction) is the final segment, never a suffix on the action name.
`explanations` maps every rule id to the message key shown in the 'why?' sheet; it is not an instruction and never appears in the primary banner (guidance-engine.md §1).
